_readme: The measured Base44 Workflows subset — the single source of truth shared by the fork's
compiler (app/core/workflows/compiler.py), the migrator's analysis gate, and the drift
probe that diffs this file against Base44's live validate-definition endpoint.
Every value here was MEASURED against Base44 production (2026-08-20..22); the evidence
per field). Do not extend this file from docs or intuition — only from a probe.

connector._note: The analysis allowlist AND the engine's adapter inventory (core/workflows/connectors.py — the gate asserts they agree). Every entry is a measured Base44 payload: gmail from the parity lab (H §14.11b + 2026-09-02: label-only changes fire with has_new_messages false), googledrive changes + googlecalendar events from a customer's own 200 runs (2026-09-02), googledrive file/file.update/file.trash/file.untrash/file.delete from the lab's six file workflows through update/content/trash/untrash/permanent-delete (2026-09-02: event_type is derived from Google's state; file.delete is subscribable but NEVER fires — a permanent delete arrives as state `remove`, which only the catch-all `file` sees, as `file`). Base44's full catalog (developer docs, 45 integration/event pairs: outlook, one_drive, share_point, microsoft_teams, slack ×10, slackbot ×5, wix ×11) is measured per integration with a LIVE connection before it lands here — never from the docs. PUSH integrations (core/workflows/push.py) since 2026-09-27: the provider POSTs to the app's own /api/connector-events/{integration} and the fork forwards the raw body, which is what Base44 does — measured on customers' own run ledgers: slackbot = Slack's Events API envelope verbatim, event_type = event.type plus the measured channel_type suffix for a message (24 runs, 2026-09-17); outlook = Microsoft Graph's change-notification envelope verbatim, event_type from changeType (6 runs, 2026-09-27). message.im/message.mpim and updated/deleted follow the SAME derivation on the same verbatim envelope; app_mention is the event's literal type. NOT served: slack (the user-token sibling), share_point, microsoft_teams, wix — no customer has one and no payload is measured, so analysis blocks them by name and emails us.
